follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger (program_requirement_records_follow_verdict, chatbox/supabase_program_record_verdicts.sql) runs on this UPDATE. Where a person's latest verdict on the row is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record, and the machine checks now pass, it marks the row checked, and a checked row is public. The UPDATE returns those rows' places as "checked". The rollback reverses this: it moves checks.arithmetic back to "unequal", the machine checks fail again, and the trigger unmarks the row.
person_settled: Person-settled rows win. The UPDATE writes checks.arithmetic alone, only where the row still holds the filed run and still reads "unequal" (the machine's value). It never writes the record, checked, checked_by or checked_at: the trigger sets those from a person's verdict, a confirm marks the row checked and any other verdict (needs a fix) keeps it unchecked. A person's reload or reread changes the run and drops the row out of the guard.
